_README2: Only fields WITHOUT underscore prefix are used. Fields starting with _ are comments.
_README3: All fields below are REQUIRED. Everything else uses universal defaults (see config.py).
_case_name: Unique name for this case. Output goes to CASES/<case_name>/
_stl_files: List of STL filenames in the STL/ directory. ASCII format only.
_fidelity: Mesh/solver quality preset: 'fast' (5-10 min), 'standard' (30-60 min), 'fine' (2-4 hrs)
_flow_ground: ground: true = moving wall at freestream speed (ground effect), false = slip wall
_outputs: Which axes to report forces on
_outputs_drag: drag_axis: direction of drag force (same as flow direction)
_outputs_df: downforce_axis: direction of downforce (typically toward ground)
_domain_box: Wind tunnel bounds: 'auto' automatically fits around geometry, or specify explicit [min, max]
_ground_style_1: Style 1 (Relative clearance): Gap in meters below lowest STL point (e.g. 0.035 for 35mm ride height; 0.0 = full car touching ground)
_ground_style_2: Style 2 (Absolute coordinate): Fixed coordinate of road (e.g. 0.0). Rename key to 'ground_plane' to use this instead of ground_clearance
_domain_faces: Assign each face of the domain box to a boundary type.
_domain_faces2: Available types: inlet, outlet, ground, farField, symmetry
_domain_faces3: Face keys: -x, +x, -y, +y, -z, +z (normal direction of each box face)
_slurm: Override SLURM settings for CU e-Science cluster here (optional)

slurm._use_tmpdir: true = run in fast node RAM/scratch with live sync to case dir; false = run in-place in case dir
